title: cenchrus glaucifolius
intro: Cenchrus glaucifolius, commonly known as the Blue Dune Grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. The Blue Dune Grass is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Cenchrus glaucifolius include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve flatulence, and soothe respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
